articles_purge_lifecycle.name: articles_purge_lifecycle
articles_purge_lifecycle.value: ("articles"."status" = 'DELETED' AND "articles"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "articles"."purge_after" IS NOT NULL AND "articles"."purge_after" >= "articles"."deleted_at") OR ("articles"."status" <> 'DELETED' AND "articles"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "articles"."purge_after" IS NULL)

articles_published_at_lifecycle.name: articles_published_at_lifecycle
articles_published_at_lifecycle.value: ("articles"."status" <> 'PUBLISHED' OR "articles"."published_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("articles"."status" <> 'DRAFT' OR "articles"."published_at" IS NULL)

assets_completed_at_lifecycle.name: assets_completed_at_lifecycle

comments_purge_lifecycle.name: comments_purge_lifecycle

events_all_day_dates.name: events_all_day_dates

permission_change_requests_actor_separat.name: permission_change_requests_actor_separation_check
